policy: Compact backup: no raw static/motion PNGs, contact sheets, caches, full baseline copy or duplicate logs. Original per-frame hashes, full decode/order receipts and source-reference hashes retained.
reproducibility_limit: Raw native captures are not recoverable from the lossy MP4. Full historical frame-to-MP4 validation requires original raw captures and layout; a new native capture requires separate authorization and fresh provenance.
